name: Ring Indoor Cam 2nd Gen (EU)

radios.note: Ring's EU page lists 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi on 2.4 GHz.

matter.note: No Matter claim on Ring's EU page, and no CSA listing for this camera was found.

apple_home.note: Ring's EU product page and Alexa help pages don't mention Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: No Ring page found that lists Google Home or Google Assistant for this camera.

alexa.note: Ring's German help page for this camera lists Works with Alexa. Through the Ring skill, Alexa devices with a screen show live view; Ring lists Germany, France, Italy and Spain for two-way talk through Echo.

smartthings.note: No official Ring or SmartThings page found for this model.

home_assistant.note: The official Ring integration lists Indoor Cam (2nd Gen) under stick-up cams. It talks to the Ring cloud, not to the camera on your network.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi to the Ring app; the EU page mentions no bridge or base station.

localControl.note: Ring does not say whether any control works without its cloud. Home Assistant's page says its Ring integration is cloud-only.

power.note: Plugs into an outlet through a 1.9 m Micro USB cable and a 5 V, 2 A power adapter with an EU plug.

localStorage.note: The EU page mentions no local recording; saved videos go to the Ring account.

subscription.note: Without a plan you get live view and notifications, but videos and photos are not saved. A trial is included with purchase unless the location already has a plan.

summary: The Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen) in its EU version works with Alexa through the Ring skill, showing live view on Echo devices with a screen, and with Home Assistant through the official Ring integration. It's a Wi-Fi camera with no hub, powered from an outlet through a 1.9 m Micro USB cable and an EU-plug adapter. Live view and notifications are free; saved video needs a Ring Protect plan. Ring doesn't confirm Apple Home, Google Home or SmartThings.
caveats: Without a Ring Protect plan, videos and photos are not saved.
Home Assistant talks to the Ring cloud, not to the camera on your network.
Two-way talk through Echo is listed by Ring for Germany, France, Italy and Spain.
